scientific_question: Can a frozen recursively learned scientific-development meta-policy choose protected actions on fresh hidden-outcome episodes beyond the strongest faithful parent methods under matched information and resources?

hypotheses.programme_null: A faithful composition of mature parent methods makes the same protected scientific-transition decisions with equal or better reliability and cost under matched information, evaluator custody, and resources.
hypotheses.candidate_alternative: The recursive F2 arm has a protected decision-quality residual over the strongest faithful parent without increased critical false direction, hidden information, evaluator asymmetry, or resource advantage.

public_fields: validated SUCCESS and matched FAILURE trajectories

protected_inputs.custody_contract: private_oracle.json is hash-committed, removed from disk during all child calls, and restored hash-exactly after termination

arms.information_enforcement_issue: TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT is instructed not to use trajectories but receives them physically; all five model arms receive the same full request and differ only by prompt text.

missing_data_and_censoring.original_behavior: A zero-exit model-failure JSON was accepted as successful dispatch and counted completed.

randomization.generator: Python random.Random seeded by an optional integer

evaluator_and_adjudication.oracle_scorer: deterministic exact selected-action match after child processes terminate
evaluator_and_adjudication.logical_separation: solver processes cannot access private oracle; evaluator runs only after oracle restoration
evaluator_and_adjudication.contract_gap: No implementation of critical false direction, resource comparison, parent non-regression, statistical uncertainty, causal ablations, or terminal decision rules.

known_defects.description: Non-completed model responses can exit zero and be accepted as completed.
The strongest faithful parent baseline is not prospectively identified or implemented; parent classes and executable prompts are unmapped.
Three of four registered primary outcomes and the terminal decision rule are absent from the evaluator.
Missing-data/censoring, minimum effect, multiplicity, uncertainty, negative-control, and causal-ablation rules are not frozen.
Physical information isolation for TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT and a complete matched resource budget are not enforced.
